items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: That's where I went to see Sydney Bessie.

ctx.x: Fredy Cap is the one who played at the Deluxe.
Did you ever go to Deluxe? Sure. That's where I went to see Sydney Bessie. Oh. That's where I went to get that. I got that pawn ticket.
That was at the Deluxe, huh?
